mapper.insert: insert into structure_note (project_id, side, note_no, note_name, source_file_path, source_locator, created_at, updated_at) values (#{projectId}, #{side}, #{noteNo}, #{noteName}, #{sourceFilePath}, #{sourceLocator}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: delete from structure_note where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side}
delete from structure_note where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side} and note_no = #{noteNo}
mapper.select: select * from structure_note where project_id = #{projectId} order by note_no + 0, note_no, side
select * from structure_note where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side} order by note_no + 0, note_no
select * from structure_note where project_id = #{projectId} and note_no = #{noteNo} order by side
select count(*) from structure_note where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side}
